title: Brief v1
description: What the custodian tells an agent for one attempt: run/brief.json. The brief's issue numbers and branch are the only targets an outbox may name. It holds no credential of any kind.

base_sha.description: The commit the loop branch starts from. The checked-out branch must contain it.

base_branch.description: The branch the loop's PR merges into. A pr-open entry's base must equal it.

branch.description: The loop branch. The agent commits here and never creates another.

ticket_path.description: The ticket file, relative to the repo root. Its spec is spec.md beside it.

issues.description: The issue numbers for `Refs #n` in commits and `Closes #n` in the PR body. Ticket files carry none.

cause.description: Why the previous attempt failed, from the attempt causes. Null when it handed back and the verdict sent the work back; `last_verdict` then says why.

from_head.description: The head to continue from. For `intent_lost`, the pushed head to produce the hand-back from.

last_verdict.description: The last verdict on the PR head, or null. Its fields are defined with the CI sensor (S-0001/8).

outbox_path.description: The absolute path of the outbox directory, as the agent sees it.

runtime_bound.description: Seconds the attempt may run before it is stopped.

allowed_effects.description: The outbox kinds this attempt may write. Any other kind rejects the whole outbox.
